name: Tempest Weather
author: David Reed
description: Bar pill and detail popup for a WeatherFlow Tempest weather station you own, reading its live data via your Tempest account's Better Forecast API.

barWidget.description: Local Tempest station conditions with a forecast popup

schema.label: Station ID (optional; blank = auto-detect from token)
Lightning alert sound: on or off
Lightning alert max distance, in your distance unit (0 = any)
Rain/snow start alert sound: on or off
Also send a desktop notification with each alert: on or off
Auto-dismiss the notification after N seconds (0 = notification-daemon default; critical alerts may stay sticky)
Poll interval for ALL alerts (lightning, rain/snow, NWS), in seconds, minimum 60
Lightning sound file path (blank = system default)
Rain sound file path (blank = system default)
Snow sound file path (blank = use the rain sound)
NWS weather-service alerts (US only): on or off
NWS alert level (cumulative): warnings | watches | advisories
NWS alert sound file path (blank = built-in)
